travelstaytion.notes: Quote API price.totalNoDiscountDecimal is the comparable total; cleaning already folded in; tourist tax = totalDecimal - totalNoDiscountDecimal.

airbnb.notes: Embedded JSON in data-deferred-state-0. Same house can have multiple listings/hosts at different prices -- always treat as a duplicate-listing scenario, not an error.

avantio.notes: Direct sites detected via crs.avantio.com script tag, not hostname. 'Not included in price (cash on site)' block is usually the tourist tax -- exclude from comparable total.

lodgify.notes: Comparable = rentalPrice.totalWithPromotions + fees.total, excluding localTaxes. Need slug + propertyId, which come from the site's own network calls, not the visible URL.

hostaway.notes: GOTCHA: headline totalPrice includes the damage deposit. Comparable = sum of accommodation + fee components only, excluding damageDeposit and tax components.

vrbo_expedia.notes: Structured identity only. Capture a bounded public snapshot and verify registration or gallery evidence. Pricing remains locked pending reconciled checkout evidence.

expedia.notes: Expedia is a separate distribution surface and must be observed independently from Vrbo. Structured identity is enabled; pricing remains locked pending reconciled evidence.

booking.notes: Needs real rendering + has bot detection. b_price_breakdown_simplified holds included/excluded/conditional charges.

marriott.notes: Structured identity only. Canonicalise the numeric Homes & Villas property URL and verify exact registration or gallery evidence. Pricing remains locked.

guesty.notes: Backend API returns nothing to a plain fetch -- must read the rendered page text (Subtotal/Fees/Total).

gotchas.note: Damage deposit folded into the headline total overstated one tested property's price by 27%. Always strip it.
Simple dHash overlapped true matches and unrelated photos on TravelStaytion's re-processed images. Use the DCT pHash in parity/core/matching.py, not a plain difference hash.
